description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Paul, Silvanus and Timothy greet the church in Thessalonica and thank God for their faith, love and hope. The Thessalonians welcomed the message with joy in spite of suffering, turned from idols to the living God, and became an example to believers everywhere.
1.sw: Paulo, Silwano na Timotheo wanalisalimu kanisa la Thesalonike na kumshukuru Mungu kwa imani, upendo na tumaini lao. Wathesalonike waliupokea ujumbe kwa furaha licha ya mateso, wakaacha sanamu na kumgeukia Mungu aliye hai, na kuwa mfano kwa waamini kila mahali.
1.am: ጳውሎስ፣ ሲልዋኖስና ጢሞቴዎስ በተሰሎንቄ ላለችው ቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰላምታ ያቀርባሉ፤ ስለ እምነታቸው፣ ስለ ፍቅራቸውና ስለ ተስፋቸውም እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናሉ። የተሰሎንቄ ሰዎች መከራ ቢደርስባቸውም መልእክቱን በደስታ ተቀበሉ፤ ከጣዖታት ወደ ሕያው እግዚአብሔር ተመለሱ፤ በየስፍራው ላሉ አማኞችም ምሳሌ ሆኑ።

2.en: Paul recalls how he and his companions shared the gospel and their own lives in Thessalonica, working night and day so as not to be a burden. The Thessalonians received the message as God's word and suffered for it, and Paul longs to see them again.
2.sw: Paulo anakumbuka jinsi yeye na wenzake walivyoshiriki Injili na maisha yao wenyewe huko Thesalonike, wakifanya kazi usiku na mchana ili wasiwe mzigo. Wathesalonike waliupokea ujumbe kama neno la Mungu na kuteseka kwa ajili yake, naye Paulo anatamani kuwaona tena.
2.am: ጳውሎስ እርሱና ባልንጀሮቹ ሸክም እንዳይሆኑ ሌሊትና ቀን እየሠሩ በተሰሎንቄ ወንጌልንና የገዛ ሕይወታቸውን እንዴት እንደ ተካፈሉ ያስታውሳል። የተሰሎንቄ ሰዎች መልእክቱን እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ተቀበሉ፤ ስለ እርሱም መከራ ተቀበሉ፤ ጳውሎስም እንደ ገና ሊያያቸው ይናፍቃል።

3.en: Unable to wait any longer, Paul sent Timothy to strengthen the believers in their troubles. Timothy's good news of their faith and love comforts Paul, and he prays to see them again and that their love will grow.
3.sw: Hakuweza kungoja zaidi, kwa hiyo Paulo alimtuma Timotheo kuwaimarisha waamini katika dhiki zao. Habari njema ya Timotheo kuhusu imani na upendo wao inamfariji Paulo, naye anaomba awaone tena na kwamba upendo wao uzidi kukua.
3.am: ጳውሎስ ከዚያ በላይ መጠበቅ ስላልቻለ አማኞችን በመከራቸው እንዲያጸናቸው ጢሞቴዎስን ላከ። ጢሞቴዎስ ስለ እምነታቸውና ስለ ፍቅራቸው ያመጣው መልካም ወሬ ጳውሎስን ያጽናናዋል፤ እንደ ገና እንዲያያቸውና ፍቅራቸው እንዲያድግም ይጸልያል።

4.en: Paul urges the believers to live holy lives that please God, keeping away from sexual immorality, loving one another and working quietly. He comforts them about believers who have died: when the Lord comes, the dead will rise and all will be with the Lord.
4.sw: Paulo anawahimiza waamini waishi maisha matakatifu yanayompendeza Mungu, wakijiepusha na uasherati, wakipendana na kufanya kazi kwa utulivu. Anawafariji kuhusu waamini waliokufa: Bwana atakapokuja, wafu watafufuka na wote watakuwa pamoja na Bwana.
4.am: ጳውሎስ አማኞች ከዝሙት ርቀው፣ እርስ በርሳቸው እየተዋደዱና በጸጥታ እየሠሩ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ የሚያሰኝ ቅዱስ ሕይወት እንዲኖሩ ያሳስባቸዋል። ስለ ሞቱት አማኞች ያጽናናቸዋል፤ ጌታ በሚመጣበት ጊዜ ሙታን ይነሣሉ፤ ሁሉም ከጌታ ጋር ይሆናሉ።

5.en: The day of the Lord will come unexpectedly, like a thief at night, so believers are to stay awake and live as people of the day. Paul closes with instructions for life in the church, a prayer that God will keep them blameless, and greetings.
5.sw: Siku ya Bwana itakuja ghafla, kama mwizi usiku, kwa hiyo waamini wanapaswa kukesha na kuishi kama watu wa mchana. Paulo anamalizia kwa maagizo kuhusu maisha katika kanisa, sala kwamba Mungu awalinde bila lawama, na salamu.
5.am: የጌታ ቀን ሌባ በሌሊት እንደሚመጣ ሳይታሰብ ይመጣል፤ ስለዚህ አማኞች ነቅተው እንደ ቀን ሰዎች ሊኖሩ ይገባቸዋል። ጳውሎስ በቤተ ክርስቲያን ውስጥ ስለሚኖር ሕይወት በሚሰጥ መመሪያ፣ እግዚአብሔር ያለ ነቀፋ እንዲጠብቃቸው በሚቀርብ ጸሎትና በሰላምታ ይደመድማል።
